mapper.sql: select t.*, w.warehouse_name as warehouse_name, m.material_code as material_code, m.material_name as material_name from erp_inventory_ledger t left join erp_warehouse w on w.id = t.warehouse_id left join erp_material m on m.id = t.material_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_inventory_ledger (warehouse_id, material_id, business_type, source_type, source_id, source_item_id, change_quantity, unit_cost, balance_quantity, occurred_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{warehouseId}, #{materialId}, #{businessType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceItemId}, #{changeQuantity}, #{unitCost}, #{balanceQuantity}, #{occurredTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_inventory_ledger where id in #{id}
